shortDescription: Manage configuration lines on Huawei VRP devices

options.name: backup
options.description: Whether to create a local backup of the running configuration.

options.name: backup_path
options.description: Optional path to write the backup file to.

options.name: keep_lines
options.description: When using C(state=replace), these lines will be preserved even if not present in C(lines).

options.name: lines
options.description: List of configuration lines to add or remove. Lines should not include parent context lines. Note: To remove lines, they must be specified explicitly. state: absent with lines=[] has no effect.

options.name: parents
options.description: Parent lines that define the context (e.g., C(interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1)). Can be a string or list of strings.

options.name: save_when
options.description: When to save the device configuration.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the configuration lines should be present, absent, or used to fully replace the block.
